about: How an Appendix B is read, as one list of cases: every JSON block fenced as ```json between the heading `## Appendix B` and the first `*End of HDTP` after it; both markers there, every fence closed, every block JSON. A case answers `blocks`, or is `refused` in exactly these words. Two repositories keep byte-identical copies of this file. hdtp-identity's is js/appendix-b-reader.json, and its four readers are held to it by their tests: js/seed.mjs appendixB (js/seed.test.mjs), the hdtp CLI's appendix_b (crates/hdtp/src/vectors/check.rs), the core tests' appendix_b (crates/hdtp-identity/tests/vectors.rs) and the Go port's appendixB (go/vectors_test.go). hdtp-spec's is vectors/appendix-b-reader.json, and vectors/check.mjs holds to it the one reader its checker and its splicer share (vectors/lib/appendix.mjs). hdtp-identity's js/seed.test.mjs holds the two copies to each other, byte for byte, reading hdtp-spec's beside it as its gate does; a change to one is a change to both, in the same pair of commits.
